text: Setting up my home lab on this thing today. Add a blue square called Nas below the Router. Then link Router to Nas, dashed please. Oh and how many squares are on the board after that? I want to be sure the Nas did not land on top of something.

Hi, it's me again with the signup flow. wait is Check a diamond? I thought I made it a diamond yesterday but it looks like a plain box now. If it is not, make it a diamond. Also color it yellow so that decisions stand out. Start should be a green circle, I think I set that already. Is Start a circle at least? Can you tell me the color of Done? I may have mixed up Done and Check. Put Done at the bottom of the canvas, the very bottom. Then connect Check to Done with a dashed line. Sorry for all the questions, it's been a long day.

okay so I'm planning pasta night and this is my little board. Paint Sauce red and Pasta yellow. Oh and connect Sauce to Pasta, the sauce goes on the pasta after all. Is the Sauce a circle? It should be one.

Alright, team reshuffle time. We have the Ceo at the top and everybody else is a mess. First, move the Cto to the left of the Ceo and put the Cfo on the right of the Cto, no wait, of the Ceo. Then line up Dev and Ops in a row, I want them side by side. Hr should be tiny, they're only two people. Also connect Ceo to Cto, Cfo and Hr, with plain lines and no arrows. Can you tell me who is the most connected? And is Hr smaller than Dev? Don't delete anything yet, I'm still thinking. Thanks, you're a star.

Drawing up a quick play for Friday's game. Make the Wr a star and the Qb green. The Rb should be small, he's the shortest guy on the team. Then put the Rb to the left of the Qb. Is the Wr connected to the Qb? Not yet, I guess. Link the Qb to the Wr with an arrow, that's the pass.

Okay, startup planning session, bear with me. Put four small circles near the Idea, I'm brainstorming. Make the Idea a big yellow star so it stands out. Could you add a diamond called Risk above the Idea? I always forget the risks. And connect the Idea to it with a dashed line. How many circles do we have now? Which shape is the farthest from the Idea? Tell me what is near the Idea as well. If it gets cluttered I will ask you to arrange everything in a circle. Thanks for your patience, I am really slow at this.

Quick floor plan question. Which one is closest to the Hall? And which is the farthest from the Kitchen? Also, is the Bath near the Kitchen? I've put them next to each other, I think. Make the Hall big, it's the main corridor. And paint the Bath blue.

Chem homework, ugh. Make the Electron a lot smaller and then connect it to Atom with a dotted line. The Nucleus should be a big red circle in the middle of the canvas. Then put the Electron to the right of the Nucleus. Does the Electron connect to the Nucleus? Not sure what I did earlier.

State machine for our robot vacuum, here we go. Running should go to Stopped and Stopped back to Idle. Idle is the start state so make it a green circle. Running should be a blue circle and Stopped a red one. Put the three in a row, left to right. Is Stopped reachable from Idle? I want to be sure the machine can actually stop. Which state has the most connections? I expect Running. Add a small gray square called Error below Running. Connect Running to Error with a dotted line, that's the failure path. Oh, and enlarge the Running state, it does most of the work. Thanks!

Game map for my D&D night. I need the Cave swapped with the Lake. Also what is near the Castle? The Forest should be green and the Lake blue. Is the Cave a circle? I think I drew it as a triangle by mistake.

Sprint board time. hey, can you stack Todo, Doing and Done in a column? and then space them out evenly up and down. Make Done green and Doing orange. Todo stays gray. Then tell me which of them is the topmost.

I'm documenting our cloud setup for the new hires, so it needs to be tidy. Does Api connect directly to Cache? And what is Db linked to? The Api should be a blue hexagon. Db should be a large gray rectangle. Cache is a small orange circle. Put the three in a row. Link Api to Db and Api to Cache. Then link Cache to Db with a dotted line, that's the write-through. Is there a cycle in this? There shouldn't be. Which shape is the most connected? And what is the degree of the Cache? Rename the Cache to Redis, that's what it actually is. Finally move the Db down 100 pixels, it's too close to the others.

Family tree for my grandma's birthday. Anna and Ben are the parents, so draw an arrow from each of them to Cara. Cara is their daughter, so make her a small pink circle. Then add a new circle called Dan to the right of Cara, he's the baby. Connect Anna and Ben to Dan as well.

Wireframe for the landing page. Just so you know, the Header is at the top, the Footer is at the bottom and the Body is white. Make the Footer small and gray. The Header should be a wide blue rectangle. Hmm, wide isn't a size, so just call it a rectangle. Is the Body above the Footer?

CI pipeline cleanup. We skipped testing this week so delete Test from the pipeline, no wait, keep it, just recolor it gray. Deploy should be big and red because it's the dangerous step. Build is green. Connect them in a chain, Build to Test to Deploy. And tell me if Deploy is reachable from Build.

So this is scene three of my comic. The Hero lives in the Town, and the Villain sits up in the Tower. I want the Hero to be big, like really big. Could you make the Hero huge and turn the Villain purple? The Sidekick needs a little name change, call it Buddy instead. Put the Sidekick just right of the Hero so they look like a pair. Is the Tower above the Town right now? Then connect Hero to Villain with a dashed red arrow, that's the chase. One more thing, who is the leftmost one? Oh, and put the Town at the bottom left. Thanks, this is for my little cousin.

Designing the shop database, and I keep redoing it. create a rectangle called Items and connect Orders to it. Make Orders huge, it is the central table. Users should be a blue rectangle, I want them all rectangles. Link Users to Orders with an arrow. Is Items connected to Orders now? It should be. How many connections do we have in total? Put Users on the left and Items on the right side. Then give Items the label "line items" so I remember. Also color Orders gold. I think that's the whole schema for today, thanks!
Connect Pc1, Pc2 and Pc3 all to each other.

City map check-in. How many circles are there? I think the Park is a green circle and the Mall is a red square. If not, fix it: make the Park a green circle and the Mall a red square. Is the Mall bigger than the Park?
Bio class, quick one. uh okay so the Membrane, it should be like orange and um circle shaped I think, yeah. Is the Cell bigger than the Membrane?

Hi! I'm sketching our backend and I need help tidying it up. Could you put Web, Auth and Queue in a row? Worker and Store should go in a column below them. Actually scratch that, make Worker and Store a row as well. After that connect Web to Auth, Auth to Queue and Queue to Worker. Is there a path from Web to Store? I suspect nothing links up to Store yet. If not, link Worker to Store. Oh, and enlarge the Queue a bit since it's the busiest piece. Last thing, put the Store at the bottom right. And make the Web a star, why not.
Party planning, birthday edition. Place a pink star at the bottom left. Name it Gift. Then add a yellow circle called Candle above the Cake. And connect the Cake to the Candle with a dotted line.

Traffic jam simulation for my physics class. The Car is red. Is the Bus red too? The Light should be a small circle at the top. Let me make it green for now. The Bus is yellow, I just remembered. Put the Car to the left of the Bus. Is the Car near the Light? I want them close but not touching. Move the Light 60 pixels to the right. Then connect the Light to the Car and the Bus, so it controls both. What is the color of the Light now? Which shape is the closest to the Light? And how many shapes do we have? Ok, that should do it.

Solar system model for the science fair, almost done. Mars belongs far to the right and tiny please. The Sun is a huge yellow circle. Earth is a small blue circle and the Moon is tiny and gray. Put the Moon near the Earth. Make Mars red, obviously. Is Mars bigger than the Earth?

Data flow for our ETL job. Hey could you hok Input up to Process and then Process to Output? thanks. Put the three in a row. Make Process a diamond, it's the decision step. Output should be a green star. Is Output reachable from Input?

Chemistry homework again, sorry. Arrows from Water and Salt to Brine please. Brine is a big blue circle, Water is a small cyan one and Salt is white. Is Brine bigger than Salt? Also tell me what's directly connected to Brine.
Make everything small. Except the Boss, make the Boss large again.

Home office layout, trying to tidy up. What shapes does the Desk touch? I only linked it to the Lamp I think, but I want to be sure. Also drop the Plant, it keeps dying. The Chair should go next to the Desk. And please make the Lamp yellow. Is the Chair bigger than the Desk? Probably not.
Setting up my defaults. From now on every new circle should be teal. And forget it for squares, I do not care about those. What are the rules now? And then add a circle so I can check it.

Public transport map of my city. Bus and Tram both go to Metro, ok? Make the lines dotted. Make the Metro a big purple hexagon. The Bus is green and the Tram is orange. Does the Bus connect directly to the Tram? I don't think there's a link. Link them with a dashed line, if there isn't one.

Okay this one is long so bear with me, I'm moving my whole team around after the reorg. Lead stays where she is, but Anna, Bo and Cy should be in a row right under her. Di and Eli go in a column on the far right. Hmm, make that the far left. Connect Lead to Anna, Bo and Cy so it looks like a tree. Di needs to be gold because she is the newest hire, and Eli stays blue. Could you also tell me who has the most links? And how many connections do we have in total? I think I made one by mistake between Bo and Cy, so disconnect those two. Then put Bo to the front, it's covered by something. If it still looks off I'll ask you to undo it. By the way thanks for being so patient with me today.
The Button is tiny, it's hard to tap. make it bigger. And color it blue.
I want Sq1 and Sq2 lined up horizontally. Then center Sq2? no sorry, put Sq2 at the center of the canvas.

Pros and cons mind map. give the Pro the label "Cheaper" and the Con the label "Slower" Make the Pro green and the Con red. Put the Topic in the center, the Pro on the left of it and the Con on the right. Link the Topic to both with plain lines.
Lab notebook sketch. Is Sample a circle or not? Make the Sample a tiny circle. Where is the Probe?

Hi! My daughter wants to draw a picture and I'm helping her type. draw a huge yellow sun at the top right and then a little house at the bottom left, house is brown and a square. and a green triangle tree near it. Now add a blue circle for a pond at the bottom center. Add two white circles at the top left, those are clouds. Is there anything red in the picture? She wants to know. How many triangles do we have? She loves counting. Could you make the green triangle bigger? She insists on it. Oh, and please undo the last thing, she changed her mind about the clouds. Thank you so much, she is so happy!

Circuit homework. Link Battery, Switch and Bulb one after the other. Is the Bulb reachable from the Battery? Also show me the whole diagram so I can double check it. Make the Battery a small gray rectangle. Color the Bulb yellow. Is the Switch near the Bulb? Move the Switch 50 pixels down.
Nope, undo that.
Redo please, I undid too much.

Network audit, as usual. Which shape has the fewest connections? Also list the blue ones, whatever they are. Make the Hub a big hexagon. Printer should be tiny and gray. Connect the Printer to the Hub with a dashed line. Is Pc1 connected to Pc2? Not by wire, I guess.

Meeting prep, I have ten minutes. Rename Agenda to Plan and put it in the middle of the canvas. Make it big and gold, it's the main thing. Create three small white circles near it for the topics. Add a red star at the top right, that's the deadline. How many circles do we have now? Which shape is the farthest from it? Maybe duplicate the star, we have two deadlines. Actually no, skip that, one deadline is enough. Could you also tell me what color it is? I forgot what I chose. Great, thanks. See you in the meeting.

Zoo map for the school trip. the Lion is next to the Zebra, and the Hippo is left of the Zebra. wait I mean below. Make the Lion a big orange circle. Zebra gets white. Is the Hippo bigger than the Lion? Put the Hippo 80 pixels down.

Duplicate the Beaker twice, I need three in total for the experiment. Then arrange the Flask and the Stand in a circle. I don't know what to do with the Burner, leave it for now. Is the Flask near the Beaker? I cannot tell from here.
Logic gate drawing, quick check. How big is B1? And what colour? Make A1 a red circle and C1 a blue circle. Then link A1 and B1 to C1, they are the inputs. Is B1 reachable from A1? I expect not.

ETL pipeline for the data team, I'm explaining it to the interns. Send Source to Clean and from Clean to Load. Is there any cycle in here? Make Source a green circle, it's where the data starts. Clean is an orange diamond because it has a check in it. Load should be a red square. Put the three in a row, left to right. Is Load reachable from Source? Which shape has the most connections? Give Clean the label "dedupe". Then add a small gray circle called Log below Clean. Connect Clean to the Log with a dotted line. How many connections do we have now? Alright, that's the whole pipeline. Thanks for the help!

Football tactics board. place a hexagon above the Goal, call it Post, and make it white. Make the Keeper a big yellow circle. The Ball should be tiny. Is the Ball near the Goal? Connect the Ball to the Goal with an arrow.

Living room layout, my wife is waiting. put the Lamp behind everything, and the Tv in front. Make the Sofa big and brown. Put the Tv above the Sofa. Is the Lamp near the Tv? Move the Lamp 40 pixels to the left, it's blocking the screen.

Star chart for the astronomy club, and I mix things up easily. Vega is bigger than Altair, isnt it? Altair is the biggest star in my chart tho, I think i got confused. Make Deneb tiny and white. Set Vega to huge and color it blue. Altair is gold. Put Altair to the right of Vega and Deneb below Vega. Link Vega to Altair and Deneb. Is Deneb connected to Altair? Which one is the most connected? Which is the smallest? Rename Deneb to Cygnus, that's the constellation. Alright, thanks, clear skies!

Project timeline cleanup. Move Test 40 pixels to the left, and Ship down 100. Also whats the position of Plan? Link Plan, Build, Test and Ship in a chain. Make Ship a gold star. Is Test smaller than Build?

Cafe menu board. Delete the Latte, it's off the menu now. Delete the Mocha as well, ugh, actually leave the Mocha, people love it. Make the Mocha brown and the Latte white. Is the Mocha bigger than the Latte?
